# nobus_network (Resource)

A Nobus network.

The Nobus API creates a network, a subnet and a router in a single call, so this resource requires a subnet CIDR and a router name and exposes the resulting subnet and router IDs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The Nobus API creates a network, a subnet and a router in a single call, so a
# network requires a subnet CIDR and a router name.
resource "nobus_network" "private" {
  name        = "production-network"
  subnet_cidr = "10.20.0.0/24"
  router_name = "production-router"

  description    = "Primary private network"
  enable_snat    = true
  admin_state_up = true
  tags           = ["environment=production", "team=platform"]
}

output "network_id" {
  description = "ID of the network created by Nobus."
  value       = nobus_network.private.id
}

output "subnet_id" {
  description = "ID of the subnet created together with the network."
  value       = nobus_network.private.subnet_id
}

output "router_id" {
  description = "ID of the router created together with the network."
  value       = nobus_network.private.router_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the network.

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) Administrative state of the network. Updatable in place.
- `availability_zone` (String) Availability zone hosting the network. Defaults to the provider `availability_zone`.
- `description` (String) Description of the network. Updatable in place.
- `dns_nameservers` (List of String) DNS nameservers for the subnet. Changing this forces a new network.
- `enable_snat` (Boolean) Whether the router performs source NAT. Defaults to `true`, which is the documented API default. Never returned by the API, so it cannot be verified after an import. Changing this forces a new network.
- `external_network_id` (String) ID of an external network to attach the router to. Changing this forces a new network.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the network. The API accepts values between 68 and 9216. Updatable in place.
- `port_security_enabled` (Boolean) Whether port security is enabled on the network. Updatable in place.
- `project_id` (String) Nobus project that owns the network. Defaults to the provider `project_id`.
- `router_external` (Boolean) Whether the router attached to this network is an external router. Updatable in place.
- `router_name` (String) Name of the router created together with the network. Required by the Nobus API when creating a network, and never returned by the API, so it cannot be verified after an import. Changing this forces a new network.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the network is shared. Updatable in place.
- `subnet_cidr` (String) CIDR block of the subnet created together with the network. Required by the Nobus API when creating a network, and never returned by the API, so it cannot be verified after an import. Changing this forces a new network.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the network. Updatable in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Nobus network ID.
- `router_id` (String) ID of the router created together with the network.
- `status` (String) Status reported by Nobus.
- `subnet_id` (String) ID of the subnet created together with the network.
- `subnet_ids` (List of String) IDs of all subnets associated with the network, as reported by Nobus.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The Nobus network ID is the import identifier. The project and availability
# zone come from the provider configuration because every Nobus read requires
# them.
terraform import nobus_network.private NETWORK_ID
```
